correctness.rationale: The 4D zonotope volume equals the sum of absolute 4×4 maximal minors. With fixed generator G and added t h_z, each of four volumes is a constant (4,12,8,24) plus t times exact piecewise-linear determinant sum in z, whose only breakpoints are −1,0,1,2. Independent exact SymPy determinant enumeration at rational z,t (including (0,1), (0,2), (1/13,1)) agrees with piecewise polynomial defect. The sign inequalities give the complete positive region −1<z<1/3, 0<t<T(z), max T(0)=2, and at t=1, 2−3sqrt(2)/2<z<1/13. Product with unit cube preserves volume defect in all d≥4. Separate continuity checks justify all real z; finite samples alone are not a continuum proof.
